title: kit.decide-config.v1
description: decide.config.json: which typed-decision backend answers, where it is, and the confidence below which a decision escalates to the big model (packages/decide, docs/DECIDE.md). Nothing about models, endpoints or thresholds lives in code.

backend.description: The key in backends used when the caller names none.

threshold.description: Default: a question whose most likely option has a lower probability returns choice "escalate".

timeoutMs.description: Per request; a timeout escalates every question of the request.

type.description: systemone: POST {url}/v1/systemone (TypeSafe System One API: a local kev server, a Bev server, or a hosted Jev). fake: answers from the fake table (tests, CI).

tier.description: Where it runs, for docs and routing; not used to pick a backend.

url.description: Base URL of the System One server.

urlEnv.description: Environment variable holding the base URL (used when url is absent).

apiKeyEnv.description: Environment variable holding a bearer key; the key is sent, never logged.

model.description: The model alias the server expects in the request body.

threshold.description: Overrides the default threshold for this backend.

serve.description: How to start this backend locally (documentation for people and agents; the client never runs it).

fake.description: fake only: question id -> option -> probability (missing questions get a uniform distribution).
